topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture objectives, reviews background concepts, and outlines the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth and survival signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in cascades such as Wnt, receptor tyrosine kinases, and TGF-beta drive autonomous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how impaired cellular differentiation maintains proliferative progenitor states in hematologic malignancies and intestinal epithelium.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how genetic alterations in p53 and mitochondrial regulatory proteins prevent programmed cell death in cancer cells.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, telomeres, and cellular senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells overcome proliferative limits through telomerase activation and evade p53-mediated senescence responses.

topics.label: Cancer metabolism and metabolic rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how oncogenic mutations rewire cellular metabolism toward aerobic glycolysis and how oncometabolites alter the epigenome.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the requirement of vascular recruitment for tumor growth, the timing of vascularization during progression, and the balance of angiogenic factors.

topics.label: Mechanisms and clinical detection of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the biological stages of tumor dissemination, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, and clinical approaches for tracking metastatic cells.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and final remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary of hallmark integration and final administrative remarks.
